name: gated-build
description: Claude builds, Jev triages the builder's own completion report, Claude finishes only if the triage says the objective is not met, Gemini tests. The gate is advisory triage, not verification

inputs.name: output_dir
inputs.description: Base directory for generated files (default from settings)

steps.name: build
steps.task:
${inputs.task}

Requirements:
- Create well-structured, production-ready code
- Include error handling and input validation
- Add a README with usage instructions

Save code to: ${inputs.output_dir}/${inputs.project_name}/src/
Save README to: ${inputs.output_dir}/${inputs.project_name}/README.md

End your reply with a section titled COMPLETION SUMMARY that lists: what was built, what you verified and how, and every known gap or unimplemented requirement. Write 'Known gaps: none' only after checking.

verdict.instructions: Compare the BUILDER REPORT against the OBJECTIVE. Choose complete only if every requirement in the objective is reported as built and verified. Choose verify_more if everything is reported as built but verification is missing or partial. Choose incomplete if any requirement is missing, deferred, or listed as a gap.

criteria.complete: Every requirement is reported as built and verified.
criteria.verify_more: Built, but verification is missing or partial.
criteria.incomplete: At least one requirement is missing or listed as a gap.

has_known_gaps.instructions: Does the BUILDER REPORT list any known gaps, TODOs, or unimplemented requirements?

steps.name: finish
steps.task:
A completion judge rated the previous build attempt as: ${steps.gate.result.verdict} (known gaps probability ${steps.gate.result.has_known_gaps}).

Objective:
${inputs.task}

Previous builder report:
${steps.build.stdout}

1. Read the code in ${inputs.output_dir}/${inputs.project_name}/src/
2. Implement every missing requirement and run the verification that was skipped
3. End with an updated COMPLETION SUMMARY in the same format

steps.name: test
steps.task:
Test the implementation.

1. Navigate to ${inputs.output_dir}/${inputs.project_name}/
2. Run the code against sample inputs
3. Verify it works correctly
4. Note any issues

Save test results to: ${inputs.output_dir}/${inputs.project_name}/test-results.md
